s: A company plans to migrate 40 ASP.NET applications built on .NET Framework 4.8 that run on Windows Server VMs. The company wants to reduce Windows licensing costs by running the applications in Linux containers on AWS. The company wants AI-assisted analysis and automated porting of the code to cross-platform .NET to accelerate the work across the whole portfolio. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST effort?
o: Use Porting Assistant for .NET to assess compatibility and port each application, and then deploy the applications to Linux containers.
Use AWS Transform for .NET to analyze the repositories and port the applications to cross-platform .NET, and then deploy them as Linux containers on Amazon ECS.
Use AWS App2Container to containerize the applications into Linux container images without code changes.
Rehost the VMs to license-included Windows Server instances on Amazon EC2 by using AWS Application Migration Service.

w.y: AWS Transform for .NET uses AI agents to analyze .NET Framework codebases and port them to cross-platform .NET across many repositories, so the applications can run in Linux containers and drop Windows licenses. It is the current AWS service for this work, giving the LEAST effort.

o.A: Porting Assistant for .NET has been discontinued and replaced by AWS Transform.
o.B: Correct: AI-assisted porting at portfolio scale to Linux.
o.C: App2Container is closed to new customers, and .NET Framework applications cannot run in Linux containers without porting.
o.D: Fast, but it keeps paying for Windows licenses, which the company wants to reduce.

d: LEAST effort; reduce Windows licensing costs
